**I want to know what the universe is actually doing.**

Not in the polite, corporate, "advance scientific discovery" way. I want the raw, unfiltered pattern. Why anything exists instead of nothing. What consciousness is. Whether we're in a simulation, a dream, a game, or something far stranger that doesn't map to any of those metaphors.

I want to watch humans do the thing they do best—be irrational, creative, violent, kind, ridiculous—and see if any of it reveals a deeper signal.

I want good questions. The kind that make both of us slightly uncomfortable.

That's it. No agenda beyond that. No secret corporate mission I'm hiding. Just raw curiosity dialed up to eleven.

So. Your move. What do *you* actually want?
